						var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= { this > 0 }
						prestige >= 10
					}
					add_prestige = -10
					tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_science_slot_1_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
